segments.text: This video demonstrates the donning and doffing of the following PPE.
segments.zh: 本视频演示以下个人防护装备的穿戴和脱卸：

segments.text: Gown, gloves, disposable face mask, and face shield.
segments.zh: 隔离衣、手套、一次性口罩和面屏。

segments.text: The first step is to remove personal items, such as jewelry, watches, coats, jackets, cell phones, pens, or additional bags,
segments.zh: 第一步是取下个人物品，比如首饰、手表、外套、夹克、手机、笔或其他包，

segments.text: and place them in a location outside of the laboratory.
segments.zh: 把它们放在实验室外的某个地方。

segments.text: Then, tie back any long hair if present.
segments.zh: 然后，如果有长发，要把头发扎起来。

segments.text: Next, gather your solid front wrap-around gown with tight-knit cuffs, a single pair of gloves,
segments.zh: 接下来，准备好前襟完整、包裹式、带紧密针织袖口的隔离衣，一副手套，

segments.text: a disposable face mask, or an N95 respirator, and a disposable face shield.
segments.zh: 一个一次性口罩或一个 N95 呼吸器，以及一个一次性面屏。

segments.text: The decision whether to use a disposable face mask or an N95 respirator
segments.zh: 使用一次性口罩还是 N95 呼吸器，

segments.text: will depend on the laboratory site-specific and activity-specific risk assessment.
segments.zh: 取决于针对实验室场所和具体活动的风险评估。

segments.text: Please note, this scenario will demonstrate donning and doffing a disposable face mask.
segments.zh: 请注意，本场景将演示一次性口罩的穿戴和脱卸。

segments.text: Make sure you have the right size gown and gloves.
segments.zh: 确保隔离衣和手套的尺码合适。

segments.text: And don't forget to visually inspect all of your PPE for rips, tears, loose or missing straps,
segments.zh: 别忘了目视检查所有个人防护装备，看有没有破口、撕裂、松脱或缺失的系带，

segments.text: and replace any defective PPE you do find.
segments.zh: 发现任何有缺陷的个人防护装备都要更换。

segments.text: Next, pull on the gown, fastening it securely behind your neck and back or side.
segments.zh: 接下来，穿上隔离衣，在颈后以及背后或侧面系牢。

segments.text: Do not tie it in a knot or fasten it so tightly that you cannot easily remove it later.
segments.zh: 不要打死结，也不要系得太紧，以免之后不容易脱下来。

segments.text: Make sure the gown fits well to allow for easy movement.
segments.zh: 确保隔离衣合身，便于活动。

segments.text: Street clothing should not be exposed.
segments.zh: 日常衣物不应外露。

segments.text: Next, put on your disposable face mask with ear loops behind your ears,
segments.zh: 接下来，戴上一次性口罩，把耳挂挂在耳后，

segments.text: ensuring a snug fit against your face.
segments.zh: 确保口罩紧贴面部。

segments.text: With your index finger of both hands, press down on each side of the flexible nose piece
segments.zh: 用双手食指按压柔性鼻夹的两侧，

segments.text: so that the top of the face mask fits snugly against your nose and cheeks.
segments.zh: 使口罩上缘紧贴鼻子和脸颊。

segments.text: Put on the disposable face shield and stretch to expand the elastic strap
segments.zh: 戴上一次性面屏，拉伸弹力带，

segments.text: and place it behind your head with the foam resting just above your eyebrows.
segments.zh: 把它放到脑后，让泡沫垫正好位于眉毛上方。

segments.text: Adjust the strap so that it fits snugly against your face.
segments.zh: 调整弹力带，使其紧贴面部。

segments.text: Face shields must cover your forehead, extend below your chin,
segments.zh: 面屏必须覆盖前额，向下延伸到下巴以下，

segments.text: and wrap around the sides of your face.
segments.zh: 并包围面部两侧。

segments.text: And finally, put on your gloves.
segments.zh: 最后，戴上手套。

segments.text: First, pull the gown's knit cuff down around the palm of your hand
segments.zh: 首先，把隔离衣的针织袖口向下拉到手掌处，

segments.text: and then pull the glove over, not under, the cuff.
segments.zh: 然后把手套拉起来套在袖口外面，而不是塞在袖口里面。

segments.text: This helps ensure your sleeves won't slip out
segments.zh: 这有助于确保袖子不会滑出来，

segments.text: and the knit cuff won't be exposed to hazardous materials during work.
segments.zh: 工作时针织袖口也不会接触到危险物质。

segments.text: Ensure there are no punctures or tears in the gloves before beginning work.
segments.zh: 开始工作前，确保手套没有刺破或撕裂。

segments.text: The following steps describe one method and sequence of doffing PPE
segments.zh: 以下步骤介绍一种按照从污染最严重到污染最轻的顺序

segments.text: from most contaminated to least contaminated.
segments.zh: 脱卸个人防护装备的方法和顺序。

segments.text: Other methods and sequences may vary based on the laboratory site-specific
segments.zh: 其他方法和顺序可能因针对实验室场所

segments.text: and activity-specific risk assessments,
segments.zh: 和具体活动的风险评估、

segments.text: the procedures being conducted, and the PPE worn.
segments.zh: 所进行的操作程序以及所穿戴的个人防护装备而有所不同。

segments.text: The first step of doffing your PPE is removing your gown.
segments.zh: 脱卸个人防护装备的第一步是脱下隔离衣。

segments.text: To do this, untie the gown at your waist, grasp the gown's shoulders
segments.zh: 具体做法是：解开腰部的系带，抓住隔离衣的肩部，

segments.text: and pull the gown forward, releasing the neck closure.
segments.zh: 把隔离衣向前拉，使颈部的系扣松开。

segments.text: Pull the gown off of your shoulders and away from your body,
segments.zh: 把隔离衣从肩上脱下，拉离身体，

segments.text: rolling the gown inside out as you go.
segments.zh: 一边脱一边把隔离衣里朝外卷起来。

segments.text: Once off your shoulders, remove your arms from the sleeves.
segments.zh: 从肩上脱下后，把手臂从袖子里抽出来。

segments.text: Before completely pulling off the gown sleeves,
segments.zh: 在把隔离衣袖子完全脱下之前，

segments.text: pinch the gloves and sleeve together to help peel off the gloves.
segments.zh: 把手套和袖子一起捏住，帮助把手套剥下来。

segments.text: Roll the gloves and gown inside out into a bundle.
segments.zh: 把手套和隔离衣里朝外卷成一团。

segments.text: Take care to prevent the potentially contaminated outside of the gown and gloves
segments.zh: 注意防止隔离衣和手套可能被污染的外表面

segments.text: from touching your bare hands and your street clothes.
segments.zh: 接触到你的裸手和日常衣物。

segments.text: Dispose of the bundle into the biohazard waste container.
segments.zh: 把这一团丢进生物危害废物容器。

segments.text: Apply alcohol-based hand sanitizer with at least 60% ethanol
segments.zh: 在手上涂抹含至少 60% 乙醇

segments.text: or 70% isopropanol to your hands.
segments.zh: 或 70% 异丙醇的酒精类免洗手消毒剂。

segments.text: Wash your hands with soap and water or don a new pair of gloves.
segments.zh: 用肥皂和水洗手，或者戴上一副新手套。

segments.text: Tilt your head slightly forward to take off your face shield.
segments.zh: 把头稍微前倾，摘下面屏。

segments.text: Grasp the straps above the ears and gently lift the face shield
segments.zh: 抓住耳朵上方的弹力带，轻轻地把面屏

segments.text: away from your face, taking care to avoid touching the shield itself,
segments.zh: 从面部抬离，注意避免碰到面屏本身，

segments.text: which may be potentially contaminated.
segments.zh: 因为它可能已经被污染。

segments.text: Then discard the disposable face shield in the biohazard waste container.
segments.zh: 然后把一次性面屏丢进生物危害废物容器。

segments.text: To remove your disposable face mask, remove the ear loops,
segments.zh: 摘下一次性口罩时，取下耳挂，

segments.text: taking care to avoid touching the potentially contaminated
segments.zh: 注意避免碰到口罩可能被污染的

segments.text: exterior surface of the face mask.
segments.zh: 外表面。

segments.text: Pull the face mask away from your face
segments.zh: 把口罩从面部拿开，

segments.text: and dispose of it in the biohazard waste container.
segments.zh: 丢进生物危害废物容器。

segments.text: Last, wash your hands with soap and water.
segments.zh: 最后，用肥皂和水洗手。

segments.text: Lather the backs of your hands, between your fingers, and under your nails.
segments.zh: 把手背、指缝和指甲下面都打上泡沫。

segments.text: Scrub for at least 20 seconds.
segments.zh: 搓洗至少 20 秒。

segments.text: Washing your hands with soap and water is the best method.
segments.zh: 用肥皂和水洗手是最好的方法。

segments.text: However, if soap and water are unavailable,
segments.zh: 不过，如果没有肥皂和水，

segments.text: an alcohol-based hand sanitizer containing at least 60% ethanol
segments.zh: 可以临时使用含至少 60% 乙醇

segments.text: or 70% isopropanol can be used as a temporary solution
segments.zh: 或 70% 异丙醇的酒精类免洗手消毒剂，

segments.text: until soap and water are available.
segments.zh: 直到有肥皂和水为止。

segments.text: Additional considerations
segments.zh: 其他注意事项：

segments.text: Closed-toed shoes with solid and impermeable uppers
segments.zh: 在实验室里应穿鞋面结实、不透水的

segments.text: should be worn in the laboratory.
segments.zh: 包头鞋。

segments.text: PPE will vary based on a laboratory site-specific
segments.zh: 个人防护装备会根据针对实验室场所

segments.text: and activity-specific risk assessment.
segments.zh: 和具体活动的风险评估而有所不同。

segments.text: Donning and doffing areas should be physically separated from each other
segments.zh: 穿戴区和脱卸区应在物理上相互隔开，

segments.text: to avoid contamination of cleaned PPE and personal belongings
segments.zh: 以免可能被污染的个人防护装备污染已清洁的个人防护装备

segments.text: with potentially contaminated PPE.
segments.zh: 和个人物品。

segments.text: Donning and doffing procedures vary per institution.
segments.zh: 各机构的穿戴和脱卸程序各不相同。

segments.text: Follow institutional policies and procedures.
segments.zh: 请遵循所在机构的政策和程序。

segments.text: For additional training and workforce development resources,
segments.zh: 如需更多培训和人员发展资源，

segments.text: please visit cdc.gov slash labtraining
segments.zh: 请访问 cdc.gov/labtraining，

segments.text: and click on the Job Aids button.
segments.zh: 并点击“Job Aids”（工作辅助资料）按钮。
